findings.title: Registered metric-alert handler cannot be instantiated
findings.description:
Changing `MetricAlertDetectorHandler` to inherit from `StatefulDetectorHandler` without implementing its abstract members makes it abstract. It lacks `counter_names`, `get_dedupe_value`, `get_group_key_values`, and `build_occurrence_and_event_data`.

`MetricAlertFire` still registers this class as its handler, and `Detector.detector_handler` instantiates registered handlers directly. Accessing that property for a `metric_alert_fire` detector now raises `TypeError`, aborting `process_detectors` rather than retaining the previous no-op behavior. Keep the placeholder concrete until the stateful implementation is available, or implement the required members.

findings.title: Shared occurrence ID makes payload assertions insensitive to incorrect contents
findings.description:
`build_mock_occurrence_and_event` assigns the same occurrence ID to every result. `IssueOccurrence.__eq__` compares only IDs, so the result comparisons and Kafka mock assertions do not verify fingerprints, issue types, priorities, or other occurrence fields.

This already hides a mismatch in `TestEvaluateGroupKeyValue.test_dedupe`: the expected occurrence is built for `"val1"`, while evaluation uses `"group_key"`. The test still considers those differently fingerprinted occurrences equal.

Compare serialized occurrence contents, or explicitly assert the important fields—including each group's fingerprint and priority—rather than relying on occurrence equality.
